review:
Gemhalla, turned up. Thor stands by the Tree of Life ready to strike Golden Shield multipliers that can reach 1,000x, on a pay-anywhere grid of runes.

It's faster-paced than the original, the max win doubles to 10,000x, and it keeps the excellent 97.17% RTP. Free spins come round about once every 168 spins, similar to the first game. If you liked how Gemhalla's multipliers build up, this raises the stakes a lot.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
